item.title: Commentary: IC does not adequately support club sports
item.description: The memories, lessons and love that softball has brought me have proven invaluable, and that is something worth protecting. This institution does not give us money and actively impedes on our ability to play and practice. Access to Kostrinsky Field, even for just one day across a semester, would be a game-changer. item.title: Dominant third quarter drives men’s lacrosse to first home win of 2026
item.description: The Ithaca College men’s lacrosse team opened up its home season with a down to the wire 9-8 win against the Nazareth University Golden Flyers March 4 at Higgins Stadium, bumping their record to 2-2. The Bombers’ productive third quarter was essential, producing five out of the nine goals and allowing just one. item.title: End User: Users should be aware of censorship on social platforms
item.description: Censoring practices need to be abolished, or at the very least, made transparent to users so they are aware the information they receive may be filtered. Users should take it upon themselves to learn more about the existence of censoring practices to avoid unknowingly becoming shadow banned.
